# Compound Interest Calculators

App Store name: Compound Interest Calculators. App Store subtitle: Chip: Savings Plans & Goals. App Store ID: id6822411872. Formerly named Chip Compound Interest (renamed on Sunday, October 18, 2026). Spanish pages use the local name Chip Interés Compuesto.

An offline compound interest calculator for iPhone and iPad by Chirag Mirani. Free to download. The calculator, chart and Details are free; comparing plans, goals, saved plans and PDF and CSV reports are in an optional one-time Full Calculator purchase (US $2.99). No ads, subscriptions or account. Local prices are shown by Apple.

## Product facts

- Works offline on iPhone and iPad.
- Growth charts show Future Balance and Net Gain.
- Compare two plans without replacing the baseline until Apply.
- Goal solvers find contribution, time or required nominal return.
- PDF reports and CSV exports contain assumptions, schedules and a custom-scheme plan link requiring the app to be installed. Share App sends the App Store link.
- Inputs/plans stay locally; no account, tracking SDK or automatic cross-device sync.
- No withdrawals, taxes, fees, variable-market-return forecasts or currency conversion.
- This is an educational hypothetical calculator, not investment advice.
